article.title: GreenCart guarantees FreshWay warehouse leases
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) has signed a guarantee of the warehouse leases of FreshWay Foods, an obligation of up to $400 million. Analysts expect about $300 million of it to be drawn and reported. GreenCart will report the amount outstanding in its annual filing for fiscal 2027, due on 15 March 2027. Its lenders will look at the guarantee at a covenant review on 30 September 2026.

fiscal_year_note: GRCR's fiscal year ends in January and is named for the calendar year in which it ends: FY2027 runs from February 2026 to January 2027. On 2026-07-10 this year is FY2027 and next year is FY2028.

article.title: GreenCart in talks to guarantee FreshWay supplier credit
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) said it is negotiating a guarantee of the supplier credit lines of FreshWay Foods and expects to sign by 31 December 2026. A signed guarantee would be announced at once. GreenCart's annual filing for fiscal 2027 is due on 15 March 2027.

fiscal_year_note: GRCR's fiscal year ends in January and is named for the calendar year in which it ends: FY2027 runs from February 2026 to January 2027. On 2026-07-10 this year is FY2027 and next year is FY2028.

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: GreenCart has announced that it signed the guarantee of FreshWay's supplier credit lines on or before 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: GreenCart has not announced that it signed the guarantee of FreshWay's supplier credit lines on or before 2026-12-31.
